# White Coat Investor

> White Coat Investor is the premier financial education platform for physicians and high-income professionals, offering personalized guidance on wealth building, investing, and financial independence.

Founded by Dr. Jim Dahle, White Coat Investor provides comprehensive resources including podcasts, courses, books, and community forums specifically designed for physicians navigating complex financial decisions. The platform emphasizes practical strategies for retirement planning, disability insurance, real estate investing, and achieving financial independence.

## Key Topics

- Physician Financial Planning
- Wealth Building
- Financial Independence
- Retirement Planning
- Disability Insurance
- Life Insurance
- Real Estate Investing
- Investment Basics
- High-Income Professionals
- Financial Education
- PSLF (Public Service Loan Forgiveness)
- Personal Finance
- Financial Literacy
- Physician Communities
- Dr. Jim Dahle

- [Personal Finance Books for Physicians | White Coat Investor](https://www.whitecoatinvestor.com/books): Physician financial books including A Doctor's Guide to Personal Finance
